Advice - Before you talk to a Recruiter, go to the library/bookstore for an ASVAB study guide. The higher you score, the better career fields offered. Be willing to wait ("delayed entry") for the career field you want. If you know the MOS/Rate that you want and your ASVAB scores would qualify for you, don't settle. Walk away if you have to -- they will get back to you.

Advice - Once you're in the military, make sure to get any illnesses and injuries documented into your medical record.

Factors to consider - Get a hold of your finances early on.
